purpose: Show one numeric measure over ordered time or sequence. This script is a single-series copy-derived variant of group_line.py, so its axis, legend, tooltip, hover, spacing, and visualStyle behavior should match grouped-line charts.

implementation.notes: Generate a normal line payload. The script keeps the group_line rendering implementation in this file but normalizes to exactly one visible line series.

rawDataContract.notes: Rows can use arbitrary key names.

semanticChannels.semantics: default visible y-axis for the single line

payloadShape.title: string
payloadShape.xScale: category (default) | time (ISO dates / epoch ms) | linear (numbers)

visualStyle.container: background, color, padding, borderRadius, fontFamily, className
visualStyle.title: visible, text, color, fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight, margin
visualStyle.grid: visible, count, color, width, dasharray, opacity
visualStyle.xAxis: visible, color, fontSize, fontWeight, labelEvery, labelAngle, lineColor, lineWidth
visualStyle.yAxis: position(left|right|both), suffix, digits, color, fontSize, fontWeight, lineColor, lineWidth
visualStyle.leftAxis/rightAxis: min, max, suffix, digits, includeZero, visible
visualStyle.line: Existing line defaults plus optional colorSplit: {x:exact existing x,field:series field,beforeColor,afterColor,beforeLabel,afterLabel}. Changes stroke colors and legend only; same coordinates/path. Missing x leaves ordinary line unchanged.; curve: straight|smooth|step-after|step-before
visualStyle.seriesStyle: field/series/name/label, color, strokeWidth, opacity, dasharray, showPoints, pointRadius, axis
visualStyle.legend: visible, position(top|bottom), align, gap, color, fontSize, markerSize, markerShape; labels show series names only
visualStyle.tooltip: visible, placement(cursor|fixed|topGrid|aboveFirstGrid), background, color, borderRadius, padding, fontSize, maxWidth, arrow, showUnit
visualStyle.positionLine: visible, color, opacity, width, dasharray; vertical x-position guide shown on hover
visualStyle.overlays: referenceLine, selectedBand, thresholdMarkers, pointMarkers; pointMarkers supports labelBox, eventTime, eventTitle, labelPosition(top|bottom), labelBackground, borderColor, labelBorderRadius, connectorColor
visualStyle.customCss: raw CSS appended inside this component

modelInstructions: visualStyle.chart.fitContent=true sizes an embedded chart frame from actual root, SVG text/legend and tooltip bounds without the default footer-height reserve; content must stay fully visible.

pointMarkers.allowCurveOverlap defaults false. When true, prefer vertical gaps and minimize covered curve length; allow limited overlap only when needed, while protecting marked anchors, card spacing and plot bounds; keep normal card typography/padding.
Use only when the x dimension has meaningful order.
Provide exactly one numeric series. Prefer series[0].field plus series[0].label so legend and tooltip display a reader-facing name.
Use right-axis defaults unless the user explicitly asks for the y-axis on the left or both sides.
Set series[0].axis='right', leftAxis.visible=false, rightAxis.visible=true, and visualStyle.yAxis.position='right' by default.
Put the metric name in rightAxis.label. Do not set series[0].suffix, axis.suffix, or rightAxis.suffix unless the user explicitly asks visible values to show units.
Use visualStyle.tooltip.showUnit=false and visualStyle.positionLine.visible=true by default.
Y-axis tick and tooltip compact-unit conversion must follow grouped-line behavior: only convert when all values in the axis or tooltip group meet the same magnitude threshold.

Tooltip boundary behavior must follow grouped-line behavior: clamp to both viewport edges, compute anchors from rendered SVG screen coordinates on small screens, align the arrow tip with the vertical position line, and hide the arrow when it would sit on the tooltip edge.

For right-side y-axes, align the y-axis description to the same right edge as the y-axis tick labels, and allow the description text to extend leftward into the chart area instead of reserving extra right margin.

For a framed two-line event annotation, use visualStyle.overlays[] with type='pointMarkers', x or index, labelBox=true, eventTime for the first line, and eventTitle for the second line. Preserve all base line-chart defaults unless the user explicitly requests a visual override.

For a verified trade/event date color boundary, use visualStyle.line.colorSplit with an exact x present in data. Bind event points with existing pointMarkers; never shift missing dates. Keep all base layout and line defaults.

When mark cards must not cover curves, set pointMarkers.labelPlacement=outside-top. The renderer reserves a separate label lane above the SVG plot, wraps all labels on narrow widths and connects exact price points; original plot coordinates and styling remain unchanged.

For irregular observation dates use xScale=time and sorted ISO dates or epoch milliseconds. Step-after holds the previous value until the next observation; step-before changes at the previous observation. missingValuePolicy=gap preserves missing observations and disconnects the line; never fill nulls silently.
